steps.name: The Place of the Oracle (1)
steps.objective: Talk to [Rosemary] in "Mars", then find [Ziskad] in "Zisk Plains".

lines.speaker: 로즈마리
lines.text: You. Weren't you finished here?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I wanted to come back once more. See if anything else had happened...

lines.speaker: 로즈마리
lines.text: It's chaotic enough already. Every time you come through, it gets worse.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Because of the mayor?

lines.speaker: 로즈마리
lines.text: Yes. Peonia posts notices and explains, but people won't believe her. Some even say she and the mayor were in it together.

lines.speaker: 로즈마리
lines.text: The Alliance of Light will send someone soon. Peonia requested it, but the funny thing is, the people who wouldn't believe her back down as soon as they hear someone from Lumen is coming.

lines.speaker: 로즈마리
lines.text: They don't even know who's been doing all the work for Mars...

lines.speaker: 로즈마리
lines.text: Well, it'll work out somehow.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I see. Then I'll...

lines.speaker: 로즈마리
lines.text: Say, do you have a decent map?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Not a particularly good one.

lines.speaker: 로즈마리
lines.text: The people of the Kingdom of Jude call this a decent map. Look at it. It doesn't show the center of the continent at all.

lines.speaker: 로즈마리
lines.text: Will I have to ask the Alliance of Light after all? The best information about this continent is in Lumen...

lines.speaker: 로즈마리
lines.text: Sorry, but go to Lumen for me. I need to keep watching Avalon. And those Demigods too...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: You're busy. I'll help.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: A detailed map of the central continent, right?

lines.speaker: 로즈마리
lines.text: Yes. Ziskad is in Lumen these days, isn't he? Go ask him. I'll tell the order the goddess's messenger helped us.

lines.speaker: 로즈마리
lines.text: The order will give you some kind of reward. Hopefully something besides more work...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: It's all right. I'll be back.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (I wonder if Ziskad is at his estate now.)

steps.name: The Place of the Oracle (2)
steps.objective: Defeat [Lethe of Oblivion] in "Lake of Oblivion" and obtain the <Howl Kingdom Map>. Then report to [Rosemary] in "Mars".

lines.text: (The moment the adventurer enters Zisk's Estate, the animals startle and scatter.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (He is here.)

lines.speaker: 지스카드
lines.text: You're back? What brings you? Is it about El?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: What? Has something happened to El?

lines.speaker: 지스카드
lines.text: No. She's just resting. She looked tired, so I told her to take a break.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I see. I'm glad she's all right.

lines.speaker: 지스카드
lines.text: Indeed. Anyway, you must have a reason for coming. Tell me, what is it?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Well...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (I explain Rosemary's request and tell Ziskad I've come to find a good map.)

lines.speaker: 지스카드
lines.text: That Battlelord is still in Eastland, then. And the Demigods have scarcely been seen... Hmm...

lines.speaker: 지스카드
lines.text: After your last visit, books from the Kingdom of Howl were found near the lake. Some seem to be missing... Perhaps...

lines.speaker: 지스카드
lines.text: You might be able to find them. What do you say? Will you take a look?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes, I will. The lakeside...

lines.speaker: 지스카드
lines.text: Are Lethe's words troubling you?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes, a little...

lines.speaker: 지스카드
lines.text: Pay them no mind. Overthinking can make even simple things impossible.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I'll remember. And about what happened then...

lines.speaker: 지스카드
lines.text: Things will work out with Medea. Don't worry too much.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Hearing you say that eases my mind, Ziskad.

lines.speaker: 지스카드
lines.text: Medea will call you when the time is right. Wait until then. And be careful at the lake. It's dangerous even with Lethe gone...

lines.speaker: 지스카드
lines.text: I'll look into Baral. There's no need for you to investigate separately.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Understood.

lines.speaker: 지스카드
lines.text: Good. Take care, as always...

lines.speaker: 로즈마리
lines.text: Demigod Belosh...
(Rosemary tears the letter in her hands to shreds.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Rosemary, I'm back.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: You look angry. Have you heard something about the Demigods?

lines.speaker: 로즈마리
lines.text: The order sent a letter. It wasn't under any special seal, so I read it...

lines.speaker: 로즈마리
lines.text: And it's infuriating!!

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: What did it say?

lines.speaker: 로즈마리
lines.text: Belosh has disappeared. They've only now discovered what happened to him.

lines.speaker: 로즈마리
lines.text: We thought Weiss's attack had merely sealed his divine power. But his mind had collapsed.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (...The effects of Binding?)

lines.speaker: 로즈마리
lines.text: The order kept him there, praying and continuing healing treatments. But he constantly tried to escape, giving them no end of trouble.

lines.speaker: 로즈마리
lines.text: Even without his power, a Demigod is still a Demigod... He defeated everyone and vanished. Now he's missing.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Is he trying to get revenge?

lines.speaker: 로즈마리
lines.text: Belosh might. He serves a god, yet he's arrogant and proud of the most pointless things.

lines.speaker: 로즈마리
lines.text: Enough to irritate even the calm Frozen sometimes.

lines.speaker: 로즈마리
lines.text: Well, he'll handle it himself. And accept the consequences himself.

lines.speaker: 로즈마리
lines.text: Damn it... That stupid man...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Hmm...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Oh, here's the map.

lines.speaker: 로즈마리
lines.text: Wow, this is excellent. The Kingdom of Howl? As expected of what was once Eastland's greatest kingdom... With this, I can get closer to Avalon.

lines.speaker: 로즈마리
lines.text: Thank you. I think I can manage now.

lines.speaker: 로즈마리
lines.text: The order will reward you, but I'll give you something too. Good information. Listen carefully.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes?

lines.speaker: 로즈마리
lines.text: Interested in an oracle?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: An oracle?

lines.speaker: 로즈마리
lines.text: Yes. A message from a god.

lines.speaker: 로즈마리
lines.text: The order recently received a divine message. More precisely, it announced the day the oracle would be delivered.

lines.speaker: 로즈마리
lines.text: You can go straight through Iris, of course. But she is still incomplete, so...

lines.speaker: 로즈마리
lines.text: I'm not criticizing her. Take that as you will.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: All right.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (...A Battlelord speaking ill of a god. How curious.)

lines.speaker: 로즈마리
lines.text: Oracles take many forms, but usually there's advance notice. "I shall deliver my message here, in this way." That sort of thing.

lines.speaker: 로즈마리
lines.text: Usually, it's somewhere considered sacred...

lines.speaker: 로즈마리
lines.text: This time, it isn't a temple of the Order of Seres. The message mentioned the Reverse Side or something. Whatever that means...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: The Reverse Side...

lines.speaker: 로즈마리
lines.text: If you're interested, gather more information. I thought it might help someone directly connected to Iris, so I told you.

lines.speaker: 로즈마리
lines.text: Hehe. Aren't you grateful?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: It helps. Thank you, Rosemary.

lines.speaker: 로즈마리
lines.text: Ugh, don't thank me with that expression. Don't look at me the way Frozen does!!

lines.speaker: 로즈마리
lines.text: You've changed so much in such a short time, it's hard to get used to. Sigh... Who are those people? I've never seen them in Phobos.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Who?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (That's Raclette and Jelic...)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Our eyes definitely met... Wait, where did they go?)

lines.speaker: 로즈마리
lines.text: Oh, never mind. I'm taking a break. What a bother. What about you? Want a drink?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: No, I've thought of somewhere I need to go.

lines.speaker: 로즈마리
lines.text: Really? Can't be helped, then.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Take care, Rosemary. See you again.

lines.speaker: 로즈마리
lines.text: Sure... Next time, let's meet when neither of us has anything to do.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Raclette and Jelic... Dayna must have sent them. Should I go to Esnil and ask her? It can't be anything ordinary. An oracle, the Reverse Side... Obvious enough, but still.)

lines.speaker: 데이나
lines.text: Of all the timing...

lines.speaker: 데이나
lines.text: Ahahaha, %s. Welcome.
(Dayna greets the adventurer with an awkward, flustered smile.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Dayna, you're acting suspiciously.

lines.speaker: 데이나
lines.text: You already know, so I won't deny it. Come sit here.

lines.speaker: 데이나
lines.text: Tea? Help yourself to whichever dessert you like. Jelic dropped off another pile today.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Thank you.

lines.speaker: 데이나
lines.text: Come to think of it, is tomorrow the day Jelic unveils his new creation? An elf mage named Soleil always comes to wait around this time.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I've heard Soleil likes desserts.

lines.speaker: 데이나
lines.text: Of course you know that mage too. Oh, sorry. The voice fairy fell into the Void Sea.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: What's a voice fairy?

lines.speaker: 데이나
lines.text: You haven't heard that, %s? It's an expression we use in Freios when a conversation wanders off-topic or goes on too long.

lines.speaker: 데이나
lines.text: Anyway, you saw Raclette and Jelic in Mars, didn't you?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Has something happened?

lines.speaker: 데이나
lines.text: Nothing much... I sent them to check on something near Phobos. It's nothing major.

lines.speaker: 데이나
lines.text: We thought you'd left Mars, %s. They must have pretended not to notice you because they were working.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: If they were on duty, I understand.

lines.speaker: 데이나
lines.text: Thank you for believing me. Have you received my sister's imperial decree?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: You know about it. I have, but it isn't time yet.

lines.speaker: 데이나
lines.text: So there's a little time left. May I tell you something? I think it's useful information...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Of course.

lines.speaker: 데이나
lines.text: Think of it as organizing your thoughts while you wait. That might help.

lines.speaker: 데이나
lines.text: We recently found traces of someone's attempt to connect the Demon Realm to this world.

lines.speaker: 데이나
lines.text: The Reverse Side's power is tremendous there. It may be the place my sister intends to name.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: ...Where is it?

lines.speaker: 데이나
lines.text: A region called Eidos. People usually call it the Sanctuary. Holy knights reside there too.

lines.speaker: 데이나
lines.text: You look as though you want to know more.

lines.speaker: 데이나
lines.text: Honestly, that's all I know. My sister could use her foresight to see what will happen, but...

lines.speaker: 데이나
lines.text: I don't know if her body could withstand it...

lines.speaker: 데이나
lines.text: Oh, never mind. You didn't hear that, %s. It makes it sound like I'm worried about her.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Right. So... I may be going to the Sanctuary next. How do I get there?

lines.speaker: 데이나
lines.text: ...Hmm. I don't know that either.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Can't be helped.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Dayna really does kindly tell me everything.)

lines.speaker: 데이나
lines.text: Only a few days left, right? Until you can open my sister's decree...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes. I'll need to go to Dragon Valley then.

lines.speaker: 데이나
lines.text: Then get plenty of rest until then.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Thank you for saying so. I'll be going now.

lines.speaker: 데이나
lines.text: Aren't you curious about anything else?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I'll learn about what hasn't happened yet in its own time.

lines.speaker: 데이나
lines.text: Heh.
(Dayna gives a meaningful smile.)

lines.speaker: 데이나
lines.text: Thank you, %s.

lines.speaker: 데이나
lines.text: Take care, then.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: You too, Dayna.

lines.speaker: 데이나
lines.text: I suppose that's why everyone likes them. My sister, Shiina... all of them.
